visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens outdoors at a temple entrance featuring a large golden rooster statue on a red platform. A woman in a beige puffer jacket and grey skirt stands with arms outstretched while a man in a black t-shirt and white shorts bends down to lift her by the thighs. (2) The scene cuts to a park with a wooden gazebo and bamboo. The same man lifts the woman in the same pose as she holds a small snack on a stick. (3) The setting shifts to a sunlit grassy field with pink cherry blossom trees in the background. The man approaches and lifts the woman again as she beams with her arms wide. (4) The duo is now indoors near a festive display featuring a tree with glowing fish lanterns and a large red drum. A toddler is seen in the background as the man lifts the woman once more. (5) At night on a street with red lanterns hanging from a building, the man performs the lifting action while the woman twirls her skirt. (6) In a bright retail clothing store, the woman holds a baby in a carrier and takes a mirror selfie. A young boy stands next to her. The man enters the frame and lifts the woman while she maintains the selfie pose. (7) In a hotel room mirror, the whole family gathers. The man holds the baby and the young boy hugs the woman. The man then lifts the woman and the baby together as the boy clings to her leg.
